name: compassion
description: Compassion Switzerland: optional Claude Code plugins for Odoo work. Install the ones you want, or compassion-bundler for all of them.

plugins.name: compassion-bundler
plugins.description: All the Compassion plugins in one install: every other plugin in this marketplace.

plugins.name: find-docs
plugins.description: Current docs for any library through Context7, and Odoo docs pinned to your repository's Odoo version.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: A real Chrome Claude drives to check your local Odoo: screenshots, console errors, forms.

plugins.name: assisted-by
plugins.description: An Assisted-by: <model id>, <effort>, claude-code trailer on every commit Claude makes.

plugins.name: ticket
plugins.description: Odoo tickets (T####) with personal data masked: read, reproduce on your local Odoo, fix and stage. Read-only on the tickets.

plugins.name: code-rules
plugins.description: Compassion's code rules, read per subject when a change needs them, an ADR recorder, and a read-only rules review before each PR.

plugins.name: odoo-rules
plugins.description: The Odoo code rules on top of code-rules: access rights, side effects in transactions, translations.

plugins.name: translation-glossary
plugins.description: Compassion's agreed words in each language, for translating or writing interface text and communications.
